definition_quote.value: 'Practice of engineering' or 'practice of professional engineering' means any of the following when done for others: (a) Performing a service or creating an original work requiring engineering education, training and experience. (b) In connection with utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works or projects, whether private or public, applying special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences to services or original works such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, and services during construction, manufacture or fabrication for the purpose of ensuring compliance with specifications and design.
